create.name: Mandala – Centro studi tibetani
create.bio:
Mandala – Centro studi tibetani is a Tibetan Buddhist association in Milan, with sister centres at Graglia Santuario near Biella (Mandala Samten Ling) and in Merano (Mandala Deua Ling). Its spiritual guide is the Venerable Lama Paljin Tulku Rinpoce, born Arnaldo Graglia in Addis Ababa in 1941 to Piedmontese parents, who became a novice in Dharamsala in 1991, received full ordination at Sera Je monastery in 1993 and in 1995 was recognised in Ladakh as the reincarnation of a seventeenth-century abbot of Atitse monastery. He now sits among the masters of Lamayuru monastery and follows the teachings of the Dalai Lama.

The programme, open to members, mixes study and practice: monthly teachings with the lama, which close with a guided meditation and a commentary on verses of the Dhammapada; an online members' course on the role of the spiritual teacher; a long online course on the twelve links of dependent origination led by Tenzin Jampel; and a monthly Saturday puja with commentary. The centre also hosts interfaith and cultural events, talks by visiting Tibetan teachers and a series on women in Buddhism, many of them filmed for its YouTube channel, which has run since 2012 and now has more than twenty thousand subscribers.

courses.title: Appuntamenti con il Lama – Percorrere il sentiero
courses.description: In-person teachings at the Milan centre with Lama Paljin Tulku Rinpoce on the place of the spiritual teacher in the Mahayana and Vajrayana path, each ending with a guided meditation and a commentary on verses of the Dhammapada. Remaining dates: 28 November and 19 December 2026.
courses.price: Il contributo per gli incontri in presenza con il Lama è di 20€

courses.title: Con la guida del Maestro – Identikit del Maestro buddhista
courses.description: An online course for members in which Lama Paljin Tulku Rinpoce explains what a Buddhist teacher is and is not, closing each session with a meditation and Dhammapada verses. Remaining sessions: 23 November and 14 December 2026.
courses.price: Contributo per il trimestre ottobre – dicembre 45€

courses.title: I Dodici Anelli del Sorgere Dipendente – corso online
courses.description: An online course led by Tenzin Jampel (Luca Straffi) on the Wheel of Life and the twelve links of dependent origination, following the First Panchen Lama's 'Easy Path', with reflections and meditations. Open to all; the introductory sessions run in late 2026 and the rest from 2027.

courses.title: La Puja dell'armonia universale – Un sabato al mese per meditare insieme
courses.description: A monthly Saturday at the centre with Tenzin Jampel: a morning puja with a ritual food offering, then an afternoon commentary on the text's symbols, teachings and mudras. Open to all, especially those who have taken or wish to take refuge; booking needed.

courses.title: Socio ordinario
courses.description: Annual membership of the association, required to take part in its activities in Milan and at its centres in Graglia and Merano.
